name: dummy
description: Standard variable storage criteria. The score only changes through commands (scoreboard players set/add/remove/operation). Does not change automatically by game events. Ideal for state machines, custom variables, timers, flags, and mathematical operations.

name: trigger
description: Special criteria that can be changed by players without operator permissions using the /trigger command. Must be enabled by a command using 'scoreboard players enable <targets> <objective>' before a player can use it. Ideal for player voting, custom menus, and interactive dialogues.

name: deathCount
description: Automatically increments by 1 every time a player dies. Useful for tracking player deaths, lives systems, and hardcore death counters.

name: playerKillCount
description: Automatically increments by 1 every time a player kills another player. Useful for PvP stats, bounty systems, and killstreaks.

name: totalKillCount
description: Automatically increments by 1 every time a player kills any living entity (including mobs and players). Useful for overall combat stats and hunter challenges.

name: health
description: Automatically mirrors the player's current health (from 0 to 20, or higher with Absorption/Health Boost). Automatically rendered as hearts when displayed with rendertype hearts. Read-only from game events, but can be updated by commands.

name: xp
description: Automatically tracks the player's current total experience points. Useful for RPG systems and custom enchanting mechanics.

name: level
description: Automatically tracks the player's current experience level (the number above the XP bar). Useful for level requirements and progression gating.

name: food
description: Automatically tracks the player's current hunger/food level (0 to 20). Useful for survival mechanics and starvation events.

name: air
description: Automatically tracks the player's remaining air supply while underwater (0 to 300 ticks). Useful for underwater survival and drowning events.

name: armor
description: Automatically tracks the player's current armor points (0 to 20). Useful for defense stats and gear verification.

name: custom_statistic
description: Tracks player statistics under minecraft.custom (e.g. minecraft.custom:minecraft.walk_one_cm, minecraft.custom:minecraft.jump, minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death, minecraft.custom:minecraft.play_time, minecraft.custom:minecraft.sneak_time, minecraft.custom:minecraft.damage_dealt, minecraft.custom:minecraft.damage_taken).

name: item_mined
description: Tracks the number of times a player mined a specific block (e.g. minecraft.mined:minecraft.diamond_ore).

name: item_crafted
description: Tracks the number of times a player crafted a specific item (e.g. minecraft.crafted:minecraft.diamond_sword).

name: item_used
description: Tracks the number of times a player used a specific item or placed a block (e.g. minecraft.used:minecraft.carrot_on_a_stick).

name: item_broken
description: Tracks the number of times an item broke from durability exhaustion (e.g. minecraft.broken:minecraft.iron_pickaxe).

name: item_picked_up
description: Tracks the number of times an item was picked up into player inventory (e.g. minecraft.picked_up:minecraft.gold_ingot).

name: item_dropped
description: Tracks the number of times an item was dropped by the player (e.g. minecraft.dropped:minecraft.diamond).

name: mob_killed
description: Tracks the number of times the player killed a specific entity type (e.g. minecraft.killed:minecraft.creeper, minecraft.killed:minecraft.zombie).

name: killed_by_mob
description: Tracks the number of times the player was killed by a specific entity type (e.g. minecraft.killed_by:minecraft.skeleton).

name: sidebar
description: Renders the objective and scores on the right side of the screen HUD. Can display up to 15 entries simultaneously.

name: list
description: Renders the score in the player tab list next to player names when Tab is pressed.

name: below_name
description: Renders the score directly below player nametags in the 3D world. Visible to other players when looking at the player.

name: team_sidebar
description: Renders the objective on the sidebar exclusively for players belonging to a specific team color (e.g. sidebar.team.red, sidebar.team.blue).

name: assign
description: Assigns the value of the source score to the target score.

name: addition
description: Adds the value of the source score to the target score (target = target + source).

name: subtraction
description: Subtracts the value of the source score from the target score (target = target - source).

name: multiplication
description: Multiplies the target score by the source score (target = target * source).

name: division
description: Performs integer division of the target score by the source score (target = target / source). If source is 0, score becomes 0 and a division-by-zero error is logged.

name: modulo
description: Calculates the remainder of dividing target score by source score (target = target % source). Useful for clock timers and cyclic animations.

name: min
description: Sets the target score to the smaller of target and source: target = min(target, source).

name: max
description: Sets the target score to the larger of target and source: target = max(target, source).

name: swap
description: Swaps the score values between the target and the source.

name: less_than
description: Evaluates to true if target score is strictly less than source score.

name: less_than_or_equal
description: Evaluates to true if target score is less than or equal to source score.

name: equal
description: Evaluates to true if target score equals source score.

name: greater_than_or_equal
description: Evaluates to true if target score is greater than or equal to source score.

name: greater_than
description: Evaluates to true if target score is strictly greater than source score.

name: range_matches
description: Evaluates to true if target score matches the specified integer range (e.g. 5, 1..10, 10.., ..5).

name: global_score_holders
description: Use persistent fake player score holders starting with '#' (e.g. '#global', '#state', '#temp') for world-level or environmental logic. Fake players starting with '#' never appear in the player tab list or sidebar.
rule: Global / environmental state must use '#global' in load.mcfunction. Never use '@a' in load.mcfunction as 0 players are connected on server boot.

name: dynamic_player_initialization
description: Initialize player scores dynamically in tick.mcfunction using: 'execute as @a unless score @s <obj> matches 0.. run scoreboard players set @s <obj> 0'. This prevents missing scores for newly joined players without triggering EMPTY_SELECTOR_ON_LOAD warnings.
rule: Per-player state machines must dynamically initialize joiners in tick.mcfunction, never in load.mcfunction.

name: positive_add_remove_parameters
description: In Minecraft Java 1.21.11, 'scoreboard players add' and 'scoreboard players remove' enforce integer min: 0 in the Brigadier parser. Negative numbers cause syntax errors. To subtract, use 'scoreboard players remove <targets> <obj> <positive_int>' or 'scoreboard players operation -= '.
rule: Never pass negative numbers to scoreboard players add or remove.

name: objective_naming_limits
description: Objective names must not exceed 16 characters in length and must only contain alphanumeric characters, underscores, hyphens, periods, or plus signs: [a-zA-Z0-9_.+-].
